responsibility: Implements the executable target logic for GCC’s MCore backend that cannot be expressed in the machine description alone. This file defines MCore-specific target hooks and support routines for frame layout and prologue/epilogue decisions, varargs and argument passing, return-value placement, trampoline emission, address and constant legitimacy checks, register-class and hard-register mode rules, operand/address printing, section and symbol encoding for import/export handling, naked-function attribute behavior, cost modeling, and backend reorganization/conditionalization helpers used during RTL expansion and final assembly emission.
same_name_distinction: Executable implementation file for the MCore port: it provides the C target-hook and helper routines referenced by mcore.h (for example address legitimacy, trampoline, section/symbol, calling-convention, and naked-function handling), whereas the other same-stem files define compile-time target macros in mcore.h, RTL instruction patterns in mcore.md, and command-line option records in mcore.opt.
